headline: Last day of Architect@Work and Forum Retail at MiCo in heavy showers, on the eve of Friday's ATM strike
taxi: High demand in the rain all day; CityLife at show closing (~18:00–19:00); busy evening as people plan around the strike.
linate: Normal business traffic; allow extra time in the rain.

headline: ATM strike: metro, bus and tram at risk 08:45–15:00 and from 18:00; Blue at Assago
taxi: Very high all day outside the 15:00–18:00 window; long queues at stations and in the centre; Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: M4 at risk outside guaranteed hours; ISF delegates start arriving; book a taxi early.

headline: ISF World Congress opens at MiCo and Blue play a second night at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close; Assago exits around 23:00; centre on Saturday night.
linate: Busy arrivals of international ISF congress delegates.

headline: ISF World Congress continues at MiCo; Jungle at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close; Assago exits around 23:00; drizzle adds demand.

headline: ISF World Congress at MiCo and Big Buyer opens
taxi: CityLife around congress and fair closing; morning rain adds demand.
linate: Business arrivals and ISF delegates; steady traffic.

headline: SIMEI opens at Rho as ISF Congress closes at MiCo
taxi: Rho at fair closing (~18:00); CityLife busy with Big Buyer and ISF departures.
linate: ISF delegates leaving and international SIMEI buyers arriving.

headline: SIMEI at Rho, Big Buyer's last day and World Business Forum opens at MiCo
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; CityLife morning arrivals and ~18:00 exits.
linate: International SIMEI buyers and World Business Forum attendees arriving.

headline: AutoClassica opens at Rho alongside SIMEI; eve of Friday's general strike, rail stops from 21:00
taxi: Rho at ~18:00 closing; strong evening demand at Centrale and Garibaldi as rail stops from 21:00.
linate: Fair visitors arriving; travellers bringing trips forward ahead of Friday's strike.
